task: W4-D — CANONICAL CANCELLATION REFUND DECISION ADMISSION

scope.slice: W4-D: AUTHENTICATED CANCELLATION REFUND DECISION ADMISSION
scope.contract: Maker prepares typed refund decision admission; Maker completes WebAuthn step-up ceremony; Checker reviews preview; Checker completes distinct WebAuthn step-up ceremony; Checker approves admission; Maker executes admission via PostgresWorkforceAuthorization.runAuthorized with registrar in callback; registrar validates maker/checker separation, passkey credentials, exact scope, and atomic insertion into canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions and canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence with AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL
scope.downstreamRefundIssuance: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization verifies durable admission provenance in canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions when evidence_classification = 'AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL'
scope.moneyMovement: NONE (zero provider refund execution, zero payout dispatch, zero settlement, zero wallet credit)

migration.strategy: Additive schema migration introducing workforce permission accommodation.refund_decision.admit, roles accommodation_finance_approver and accommodation_refund_preparer, tables canonical_cancellation_refund_admission_preparations and canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions, check constraint expansion on canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence allowing AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL, routines admit_cancellation_refund_decision, get_admitted_cancellation_refund_decision, and updated issue_cancellation_refund_authorization requiring durable admission provenance for AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL

NegativeControl.title: Missing-Registrar Negative Control: SQLSTATE 42883 before migration 062
NegativeControl.evidence: Calling admit_cancellation_refund_decision against pre-062 schema fails with SQLSTATE 42883 (undefined_function)

A01.title: Positive end-to-end chain: Maker prepare -> Maker passkey -> Checker preview -> Checker passkey -> Checker approve -> Maker runAuthorized -> registrar admission
A01.evidence: Full dual-custody ceremony completes; admission row inserted; decision evidence inserted with AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL and permitted_issuer_role = 'encho_refund_issuer'; workforce authorization consumed and stamped with consumed_transaction_id; zero refund authorizations created by admission

A02.title: Maker self-checker and unauthorized checkers rejected
A02.evidence: Maker attempting to approve own preparation rejected with MAKER_CHECKER_CONFLICT; staff identity lacking accommodation.refund_decision.admit permission rejected with PERMISSION_DENIED

A03.title: Session & Step-Up negative controls
A03.evidence: Preparation or approval without active staff session rejected with STAFF_SESSION_REQUIRED; missing WebAuthn factor rejected with STEP_UP_REQUIRED; expired or forged assertion rejected with STEP_UP_INVALID / FACTOR_INVALID

A04.title: Material packet tampering after approval rejected
A04.evidence: Altering decision_ref, amount, or reason after approval alters command fingerprint, triggering COMMAND_CONFLICT or COMMAND_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH

A05.title: Canonical domain exclusions enforced at preparation preview
A05.evidence: Active uncancelled reservation rejected with CANCELLATION_NOT_FOUND; sealed V2 reservation rejected with V2_CANCELLATION_EXCLUDED; approved amount exceeding captured ceiling rejected with AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE_CEILING; non-INR currency rejected with CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED

A06.title: Guarded Replay and cross-maker execution denial
A06.evidence: Replaying identical command by original Maker returns stored admission with replayed = true; different maker or unauthorized staff attempting replay denied with PERMISSION_DENIED

A07.title: Concurrency: identical race convergence and competing distinct serialization
A07.evidence: Concurrent identical execution converges cleanly where winner inserts and loser recovers via replayed = true with POLICY_CHANGED recovery; competing distinct command for same reservation serializes on reservation root lock and raises REFUND_ALREADY_ADMITTED

A08.title: Injected failure rollback restores APPROVED status and zero domain rows
A08.evidence: Simulated database failure during runAuthorized rolls back transaction; preparation remains in APPROVED status ready for retry; zero rows persisted in admissions or evidence tables

A09.title: Lost COMMIT acknowledgement / uncertainty recovery
A09.evidence: When caller experiences network disconnection or timeout after database commits, subsequent retry finds existing admission via getAdmittedRefundDecision and returns replayed = true without re-executing authorization consumption

A10.title: Downstream issue_cancellation_refund_authorization acceptance & negative controls
A10.evidence: Calling issue_cancellation_refund_authorization with evidence_classification = 'AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL' succeeds and verifies admission provenance; forged evidence without admission provenance rejected with ADMISSION_PROVENANCE_NOT_FOUND

A11.title: Immutability triggers and zero side effects
A11.evidence: Direct UPDATE or DELETE on preparations and admissions tables rejected by SQLSTATE P0001 immutability triggers; successful admission causes zero mutations across unrelated canonical domain tables

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Missing-Registrar Negative Control: admit_cancellation_refund_decision absent prior to migration 062
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Verified in focused test suite; invoking routine before applying migration 062 fails with SQLSTATE 42883

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Dual custody: Maker and Checker must be distinct staff identities
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: canonical_cancellation_refund_admission_preparations check constraint and admit_cancellation_refund_decision routine header reject maker_staff_id = checker_staff_id with MAKER_CHECKER_CONFLICT; verified in focused test A02

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Staff session required for both preparation and approval ceremonies
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: CanonicalRefundDecisionAdmissionService requires active StaffSessionContext for both prepare and approve, raising STAFF_SESSION_REQUIRED when absent; verified in focused test A03

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Step-up WebAuthn passkey assertion required for both Maker and Checker
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: WorkforceStepUp.evaluateStepUp verifies valid user-presence WebAuthn assertion with fresh monotonic counter; missing or forged assertion rejected with STEP_UP_REQUIRED or STEP_UP_INVALID; verified in focused test A03

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Permission accommodation.refund_decision.admit required for approval and execution
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: PostgresWorkforceAuthorization.runAuthorized checks permission catalog and role grants, rejecting unauthorized staff with PERMISSION_DENIED; verified in focused test A02

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Material packet tampering after approval rejected by command fingerprint mismatch
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: PrivilegedActions.fingerprint includes decision_ref, amount, currency, and reason; altering fields after approval produces mismatched hash rejected by evaluate; verified in focused test A04

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Natural canonical domain exclusions: uncancelled, sealed V2, excess amount, non-INR
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: CanonicalRefundDecisionAdmissionService.deriveCanonicalPreview validates reservation state, cancellation release version, captured ceiling, and currency; verified in focused test A05

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Guarded idempotent replay returns existing admitted record with replayed = true
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: admitRefundDecision checks existing admission before runAuthorized and inside registrar; replaying identical command returns replayed = true without consuming fresh authorization; verified in focused test A06 and A09
admitRefundDecision validates that replaying caller matches original maker_staff_id, rejecting other staff with PERMISSION_DENIED; verified in focused test A06

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Concurrent identical admissions serialize and recover safely
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Reservation root lock and workforce authorization consumption serialize concurrent callers; losing caller detects existing admission on POLICY_CHANGED recovery and returns replayed = true; verified in focused test A07

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Competing distinct admissions for the same reservation rejected
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Unique constraint on reservation_id in canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions and reservation root locking reject competing distinct commands with REFUND_ALREADY_ADMITTED; verified in focused test A07

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Injected execution failure leaves database clean and restores APPROVED state
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Transactional boundary ensures failure during runAuthorized rolls back all mutations; preparation remains APPROVED for retry; verified in focused test A08

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Downstream issue_cancellation_refund_authorization verifies durable admission provenance
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Updated issue_cancellation_refund_authorization routine checks canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions when evidence_classification = 'AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL'; verified in focused test A10

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Zero refund authorizations created during admission
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Admissions process inserts records into canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions and canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence only; count(*) of canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations remains 0; verified in focused test A01

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Preparations and admissions tables are immutable against UPDATE and DELETE
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Triggers trg_canonical_refund_prep_immutable and trg_canonical_refund_admissions_immutable prevent illegal mutations; verified in focused test A11

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: External payment provider refund execution (Razorpay / Stripe)
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Out of scope for W4-D admission slice; zero payment provider API calls made

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Money movement, ledger settlement, payout dispatch, or wallet crediting
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Admission authorizes refund decision only; zero financial money movement occurs

trustBoundariesAndLimitations.humanApprovalAdmission: Refund decision admission implements dual-custody human approval with WebAuthn passkey step-up authentication. Evidence admitted via this workflow is classified AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_APPROVAL and references durable admission provenance in canonical_cancellation_refund_admissions.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.zeroRefundAuthorizationsCreated: Admission creates decision evidence ONLY. It does NOT create a refund authorization row in canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations. Authorizations must be issued downstream via issue_cancellation_refund_authorization by role encho_refund_issuer.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.zeroMoneyMovement: This slice authorizes refund decisions within the canonical database only. Zero money movement, zero Razorpay/Stripe API dispatch, zero payout execution, zero wallet crediting, and zero ledger settlement occur.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.noRemainingRefundableBalanceAccounting: This slice does not maintain a cumulative refund ledger or remaining refundable balance. Future slices must enforce partial-refund accounting before settlement.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.publicSurface: Zero public HTTP/REST/GraphQL routes or UI elements are exposed. All functionality is internal staff service and database routines.
